AccessEditRequestStatus.description: Actor-scoped exact-target access edit status. An applied user is the immutable public commit snapshot, not necessarily the account’s current state. not_found is noncausal while a PUT may be in flight; cancellation fences only an absent request and cannot undo an applied edit.

UserRequestStatus.description: Actor-scoped, secret-free current status. not_found is not cancellation: an in-flight POST may still commit. A repeated keyed POST always conflicts; cancel fences a late create only when it wins the writer transaction.

ResetRequestStatus.description: Actor-scoped, exact-target, secret-free reset issuance status. A negative read does not fence an in-flight POST. Issued active is true only while this exact code verifier remains current and unexpired for an enabled account. Cancellation revokes the exact still-current unused code and fences late issuance; it cannot undo a code already redeemed.

config.description: Canonical Vector configuration; unknown properties are preserved. Secrets and unsafe capabilities are validated independently.

variables.description: Draft-owned nonsecret scalar replacement slots, captured immutably in each published version. Paths are canonical RFC6901 pointers to existing leaves; server validation rejects structural and known credential fields and rechecks each rendered configuration against target capabilities.

archived.description: Organization/editing state only. Archived drafts cannot be saved, restored or published; all immutable versions remain readable and deployable.

PipelineRequestLookup.description: Nested request_id must equal the outer key. A duplicate result UUID must differ from its source. Current result contents may have changed since creation; original operation/source metadata remains immutable.

name.description: Nonempty, at most 120 UTF-8 bytes, with no NUL character. The byte bound is enforced by the server and dashboard.

PolicyRequestLookup.description: The outer request identity must match the nested receipt and the expected actor-scoped request. A negative read does not prove an in-flight request cannot still commit.

configuration_mode.description: Locally granted capability profile reported by the device; omission means restricted. Never writable through remote policy.

status.description: Computed status. awaiting_first_check_in: enrolled but never checked in. offline: more than three check-in intervals late.

retry_preconditions.description: Retry requires the reviewed desired version and generation plus current retryable state and enabled sync.

desired_sha256.description: Exact rendered artifact digest for the currently released device generation. Version identity, delivered artifact bytes, and actual managed-file digest are distinct.

reported_apply_state.description: Agent-reported workload state, separate from progress of the current desired assignment.

check_in_seconds.description: Current check-in interval; until the agent acknowledges a policy change, the longer of the old and new interval.

running_version.description: Last verified managed version on the host, which keeps running after a failed update or a removed assignment. Null means no managed version was ever verified (the host runs its adopted local config).

rollback_idempotency.description: This server supports durable actor-scoped rollback request identities.

rollback_review.description: This server supports read-only rollback scope review and a transactionally checked review token.

request_correlation.description: Keyed create/rollback receipts and exact request lookup echo durable request, operation and source identity.

rollback_idempotency.description: This server supports durable actor-scoped rollback request identities.

rollback_review.description: This server supports read-only rollback scope review and a transactionally checked review token.

request_correlation.description: Keyed create/rollback receipts and exact request lookup echo durable request, operation and source identity.

canary_gate.description: Present only on the single-deployment summary for active/paused canaries; omitted from paged history and other rollout states. Absence does not establish readiness.

rollback_available.description: Some released current target recorded a previously managed version.

DeploymentSummary.description: Status is the assignment lifecycle. status_before_removal and status_before_rollback keep how the rollout itself ended when an assignment is later removed, replaced or rolled back.

request_history.description: Supporting servers offer authenticated actor-scoped committed deployment request discovery.

gate_reason.description: Current gate blocker for this target of an active/paused canary. Null also covers pending or no-longer-targeted rows and must not be interpreted as verified. Omitted outside this context or by older servers.

replaced_by.description: For a removed row: the deployment that replaced this assignment on the device.

diagnostic.description: First sanitized diagnostic the agent reported for this exact candidate, when available.

check_in_seconds.description: Longest interval the agent may currently take between check-ins.

timeline.description: Recorded apply-state changes after release, oldest first. Heartbeats can skip states.

request_id.description: Optional durable create identity scoped to the authenticated actor. Reuse only with the identical payload.

replaces.description: Existing assignments of the same resource that this deployment explicitly replaces on the selected devices. Until this deployment releases a device the replaced assignment keeps it; each release retires the replaced assignment there (history kept, persistent selectors exclude the device). An assignment left with nothing to deliver is retired (status unassigned, status_before_removal kept). Without replaces, equal-priority different payloads still conflict. A replaced assignment that changed or no longer selects any of these devices returns 409 REPLACEMENT_CHANGED.

policy_id.description: Saved agent settings a policy deployment applies. The policy must equal their current values, otherwise preview and creation return 409.

DeploymentReceipt.description: Current original result with response-only durable request identity. For rollback, result ID differs from source ID. Mutable deployment state and targets need not equal the original request.

DeploymentRequestStatus.description: Outer request_id, operation and source_deployment_id must exactly match the nested receipt and the locally frozen operation. A negative read is not proof an in-flight request failed.

outcome.description: replace: the device moves from the listed replaced assignment when this deployment releases it.

winner.description: The assignment that currently wins for this device and resource, possibly not yet released.

replaces.description: The requested replacement that covers this device.

request_correlation.description: Keyed create/rollback receipts and exact request lookup echo durable request, operation and source identity.

replacements.description: The effect of the requested replaces list. retires_assignment is true when nothing is left for the replaced assignment to deliver, including future members of a persistent selector.

suggested_replaces.description: Current winners of the same pipeline (or any agent settings) with a different payload, which a reviewed deployment would normally replace.

suggested_priority.description: Highest priority among suggested replacements, to reuse.

winning_priority.description: Lowest priority that would outrank every existing winner on conflicting or outranked devices, when one exists.

paused_device_ids.description: Configuration targets whose sync is paused; they apply the change after sync resumes.

TokenRequestStatus.description: Actor-scoped exact creation identity. Lookup never reveals a secret. A negative read is not cancellation; cancellation fences late creation and revokes the mapped token atomically.

DeviceRecoveryRequestStatus.description: Current administrator own recovery request bound to its original device UUID. Record recovery_device_id must equal envelope device_id, and recovery_name must equal the reviewed expected_name. No secret replay. A negative read does not fence late issuance. Cancellation revokes only the mapped token; completed replacement identities remain unchanged.

DeviceRecoveryRequest.description: Empty legacy request or strict correlated request. The expected name must exactly match the original source device on first issuance. Same actor/request key cannot be rebound to another device or reviewed name.

configuration_mode.description: Locally granted capability profile reported by the device; omission means restricted. Never writable through remote policy.

sha256.description: Digest of exact target-specific rendered artifact bytes, not necessarily the published base-version digest.

payload.description: Exact UTF-8 JSON Manifest bytes, decoded before signature verification

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over exact decoded payload

CanaryGate.description: Read-only current canary evidence, separate from historical progress. Each released target contributes exactly once to verified_count or one reason. Only observing has a nonnull observation start and requires every released target to be currently verified. Counts and evaluation share a read snapshot; no countdown or future release promise.

artifact_sha256.description: Null when the device had no previously managed version before this deployment; the preview is then blocked with PRIOR_VERSION_UNKNOWN.

RollbackPreview.description: Complete metadata-only historical scope, bounded to 10000 distinct device UUIDs across both lists. Ready requires at least one eligible device, a common previous version and no blockers. Each eligible target exposes the exact prior artifact digest, never its bytes or binding values. Names are display-only. The token binds source, exact eligible/excluded identities and reasons, prior version, prior target artifact digests and generations, admission and current assignment state.

AssignmentRemovalPreview.description: Read-only removal simulation. Every device identity is distinct, ready is true exactly when blockers is empty, and an empty ready scope is allowed. Fingerprint binds the actor, source and meaningful current/projected delivery state, not display metadata or telemetry. Configuration removal can retain local workload; policy removal can restore defaults. Pending candidates are not delivered assignments.

ScheduledRefreshPreview.description: Read-only comparison of the saved scheduled snapshot and current selector resolution. Device identities are distinct within each list; the combined union is bounded to10000. Ready is true exactly when blockers is empty; an empty proposed selection is blocked. New UUIDs without complete typed bindings produce VARIABLE_BINDING_REQUIRED; the actor-bound token covers frozen bindings, source settings, saved/proposed membership and an internal monotonic revision so delayed requests cannot overwrite a newer review, including an ABA change. Matching no-op does not mutate or audit. Names and connection status are display metadata. Current saved selection does not attribute an earlier request or establish activation.

AssignmentDescription.description: Display metadata for an assignment. Names and numbers only: never selectors, targets, variable values or artifacts.

device_ids.description: Every device in the group, bounded; devices lists the first few with names.

RolloutLanes.description: Waves recovered from persisted release times; queued waves follow the scheduler order (pending targets by device ID, canary first, then batches). Failures group current failed targets by diagnostic or error.

outdated_device_count.description: Applied from this template before its latest edit; they keep the earlier values until it is applied again.

SavedPolicyListItem.description: Applied devices are live devices whose winning settings assignment was applied from this template, or (for assignments made before templates were linked) carries exactly these settings.

GroupMembershipPreview.description: Read-only simulation of a membership edit with the real resolver, rolled back afterwards. pending names a winning assignment that has not released the device yet.
